title: A muggy downtown area
content: Hello, this is my first post here! I feel a weird sense of relief knowing there are other people who dream of similar regions. In my personal experience with these dreams, there's a very humid downtown area, almost feels like it could be near the ocean. I can feel warm bricks under my feet as I walk, they almost feel like they've been rained on. There are endless strips of stores, restaurants, etc. It's usually quite busy there. As you're going out of the downtown area, there's sort of a more modern strip mall, as well as some office spaces. An old theater that's seemingly underground and a moving walkway (like a conveyor belt for people) runs through that whole strip, and stops at the stairs for the theater. On the outskirts of this little place, a colder, more industrial area. Smoke stacks, barbed wire, some schools, trailers, houses, and a very old mall. It's cold but humid here. This area is where bad things have happened in dreams. I just wanted to share my experience, and say I'm really glad to have found some people with similar experiences!
